title: RankNova — SEO Tools Website
description: A public SEO utilities demo with a page audit interface, meta tag generator and structured-data generator.
problem: How can several common SEO tasks be presented in one practical interface while avoiding fabricated audit results?
role: Portfolio tooling project: tool interfaces, iterative implementation and publication in the linked public repository.
work: Separate interfaces for SEO audit, metadata generation and JSON-LD markup.
Public tool and informational pages with documented security considerations.
result: Source code includes three SEO tool interfaces and public project pages. Actual remote-audit availability depends on backend deployment; no traffic, rankings or customer results are claimed.

title: Moavia SEO Pro — Dark Theme Website
description: A separate dark-theme one-page website concept for a digital marketing brand; it is not a client case study.
problem: How might a dark-themed landing page organize service information, navigation and project enquiries?
role: Personal front-end website concept maintained as a GitHub Pages prototype.
work: Single-page marketing layout and responsive section navigation.
Interactive interface elements and contact-form presentation.
result: An HTML/CSS/JavaScript prototype exists in the public repository. Promotional metrics shown by the old concept are illustrative, not verified client outcomes.

title: Moavia SEO Pro — Multi-Page Website
description: A distinct multi-page static website concept built to explore service-page information architecture.
problem: How can visitors browse several services, information pages and enquiries without a complex runtime?
role: Personal static-site prototype and content/navigation implementation in a public repository.
work: Standalone service, About, Contact and Privacy pages.
Responsive layouts, illustrative planning calculator and basic front-end interactions.
result: A multi-page static website and supporting source files are published in the repository. Pricing examples are not confirmed offers; no paid-client or conversion results are asserted.

title: Umm-E-Aiman — Institute & Hostel Website
description: A publicly linked portal prototype with separate institute and girls-hostel information flows.
problem: How can hostel facilities, institute courses, enquiries and other information be organized in one navigable experience?
role: Portfolio portal interface and navigation implementation in a public repository; no paid-client relationship is claimed.
work: Separate page routes for hostel and institute content.
Enquiry and booking interface components, galleries and administrative UI.
result: Source code includes the portal routes and interface components. Availability, admissions and actual institutional use require independent confirmation; no measured outcomes are claimed.

title: Moavia SEO Pro — Android App Starter
description: Public Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android starter repository. The current app displays a basic “Hello Android!” greeting; SEO features are not implemented or released.
problem: How can an Android project be initialized as a foundation for a possible future Moavia SEO Pro mobile experience without implying an app has already launched?
role: Personal Android starter code repository using a Compose activity, theme files and Android project configuration.
work: AndroidManifest.xml with a launcher activity and application label.
MainActivity.kt with a Jetpack Compose scaffold and basic Hello Android greeting.
Gradle build configuration, launcher icons, theme resources and placeholder tests.
result: The public GitHub code shows a basic starter screen, not a finished mobile SEO application. No Play Store listing, published APK, working Gemini assistant, production integration or user results are claimed.
